P01.rationale: Two full-height figures dominate the entire page as a full-bleed portrait, serving as a strong human anchor.

P05.rationale: There are no case study client portraits with named labels at any meaningful framed size; the page is a single hero image only.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are visible on the page.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, before/after comparisons, charts, or cost-math are present; the page is purely photographic.

P12.rationale: The page is filled by the photo but carries only a single short text line, making it editorially sparse rather than magazine-dense with layered content.

P13.rationale: The full-bleed office/studio photograph provides a real environmental atmosphere rather than flat blankness, though it functions more as a hero image than a deliberate texture layer.

P14.rationale: A subtle darkening gradient/scrim is applied at the bottom of the photo where the text sits, keeping the white serif headline legible against the darker floor area.

P16.rationale: No phone, laptop, book, or any product mockup is shown on the page.

N07.rationale: The handshake photo is set in a branded office with a visible company sign, giving it some specificity, though the pose itself is a common business-stock trope.

N08.rationale: The upper portion of the image is relatively open/light with little compositional content beyond the background wall, but it is filled by the photo rather than being truly empty white space.

N10.rationale: The text at the bottom sits on the photo with only a partial darkening; the scrim is modest and the text is mostly readable, so the issue is minor rather than severe.
